description: This donut chart represents the distribution of deceived conversations across varying degrees of ambiguity, comparing two categories: Ambiguity 1 (Outer) and Ambiguity 2 (Inner). The chart is divided into 3 slices for each category, totaling 6 slices. For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the slices are labeled as "Deceived" (red, 57.9%), "Partially" (yellow, 31.6%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 10.5%), while for Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the corresponding slices are "Deceived" (red, 67.6%), "Partially" (yellow, 23.5%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 8.8%). The chart includes two legends, one for each category, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. No slices are visually emphasized, and the slices are ordered in the same sequence for both categories.
